scopeNote: Covers code cases and permits handled by the City of Mesa. Neighboring Maricopa County cities such as Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe and Gilbert, and unincorporated county areas, keep their own records.

violations.coverage: Mesa Code Compliance cases, about 82,000 opened June 2017 to present, including building and sign issues.

permits.coverage: Mesa building permits that have been issued, about 148,000 from 1987 to present. Applications not yet issued carry no issue date and are left out.

source.name: City of Mesa Open Data
source.license: Public record (City of Mesa; see the portal's terms of use)
source.currentRecordsNote: Code Compliance cases and building permits are both published by the City of Mesa on its open-data portal.
